name: necromancer
description: mods/necromancer: a skeleton warrior is raised, shows on the HUD line, answers the bare /necromancer command and returns to the ground. Needs necromancer switched on (a copy of mods/necromancer with "enabled": true, installed as emf\mods\necromancer) and tools/models/model_viewer (god mode), e.g. scripts/game_session.ps1 start -Mods <copy>=necromancer,tools/models/model_viewer, and a LOCAL world.

steps.expect: /necromancer raise | spirits | list | gather | attack | dismiss
